spec_text:
---- MODULE W4Od17m2p0t1 ----
EXTENDS Naturals, FiniteSets

CONSTANTS Txns, Parts

VARIABLES cs, locked, votes, decided, holder

TypeOK ==
    /\ cs \in [Txns -> {"idle", "wait", "done", "abort"}]
    /\ locked \in [Parts -> Txns \cup {"none"}]
    /\ votes \subseteq [t : Txns, p : Parts, ok : BOOLEAN]
    /\ decided \in [Txns -> {"none", "commit", "abort"}]
    /\ holder \in Txns \cup {"none"}

Init ==
    /\ cs = [t \in Txns |-> "idle"]
    /\ locked = [p \in Parts |-> "none"]
    /\ votes = {}
    /\ decided = [t \in Txns |-> "none"]
    /\ holder = "none"

Prepare(t) ==
    /\ cs[t] = "idle"
    /\ cs' = [cs EXCEPT ![t] = "wait"]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<locked, votes, decided, holder>>

VoteYes(t, p) ==
    /\ cs[t] = "wait"
    /\ locked[p] = "none"
    /\ locked' = [locked EXCEPT ![p] = t]
    /\ votes' = votes \cup {[t |-> t, p |-> p, ok |-> TRUE]}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<cs, decided, holder>>

VoteNo(t, p) ==
    /\ cs[t] = "wait"
    /\ locked[p] # "none"
    /\ locked[p] # t
    /\ votes' = votes \cup {[t |-> t, p |-> p, ok |-> FALSE]}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<cs, locked, decided, holder>>

AllYes(t) == \A p \in Parts : [t |-> t, p |-> p, ok |-> TRUE] \in votes

Commit(t) ==
    /\ cs[t] = "wait"
    /\ decided[t] = "none"
    /\ AllYes(t)
    /\ holder = "none"
    /\ decided' = [decided EXCEPT ![t] = "commit"]
    /\ holder' = t
    /\ cs' = [cs EXCEPT ![t] = "done"]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<locked, votes>>

Abort(t) ==
    /\ cs[t] = "wait"
    /\ decided[t] = "none"
    /\ \E p \in Parts : [t |-> t, p |-> p, ok |-> FALSE] \in votes
    /\ decided' = [decided EXCEPT ![t] = "abort"]
    /\ cs' = [cs EXCEPT ![t] = "abort"]
    /\ locked' = [p \in Parts |-> IF locked[p] = t THEN "none" ELSE locked[p]]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<votes, holder>>

Release(t) ==
    /\ holder = t
    /\ holder' = "none"
    /\ cs' = [cs EXCEPT ![t] = "idle"]
    /\ locked' = [p \in Parts |-> IF locked[p] = t THEN "none" ELSE locked[p]]
    /\ decided' = [decided EXCEPT ![t] = "none"]
    /\ votes' = {v \in votes : v.t # t}

Recover(t) ==
    /\ cs[t] = "abort"
    /\ cs' = [cs EXCEPT ![t] = "idle"]
    /\ decided' = [decided EXCEPT ![t] = "none"]
    /\ votes' = {v \in votes : v.t # t}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<locked, holder>>

Next ==
    \/ \E t \in Txns : Prepare(t)
    \/ \E t \in Txns, p \in Parts : VoteYes(t, p)
    \/ \E t \in Txns, p \in Parts : VoteNo(t, p)
    \/ \E t \in Txns : Commit(t)
    \/ \E t \in Txns : Abort(t)
    \/ \E t \in Txns : Release(t)
    \/ \E t \in Txns : Recover(t)

HolderLocked ==
    holder # "none" => (\A p \in Parts : locked[p] = holder)
====
nl:
An airport baggage router coordinates competing bag batches that each need
exclusive use of a single high-speed sortation chute. A coordinator runs a
two-phase commit over a set of participant sorters: it opens a transaction
(Prepare); each sorter either grants its local lock and votes yes (VoteYes),
or, if it has already granted its lock to another batch, votes no (VoteNo).
Because acknowledgements travel over an unordered network, votes are collected
as an unordered set and may be observed in any order. When every sorter has
voted yes and the chute is free, the coordinator commits and takes the chute
(Commit); if any sorter has voted no the coordinator aborts and releases that
batch's local locks (Abort). A batch that finished with the chute eventually
releases the chute together with all of its participant locks so that another
batch may proceed (Release). A batch whose transaction was aborted is later
reset back to idle so its coordinator can retry (Recover).
SAFETY PROPERTY: whenever a batch holds the sortation chute, every participant sorter is locked to that same batch.

spec_text:
---- MODULE W4Od4m9p1t3 ----
EXTENDS Naturals, Sequences

CONSTANTS Workers, MaxE

VARIABLES epoch, rec, history, readEpoch, preparing

TypeOK ==
    /\ epoch \in 0..MaxE
    /\ rec \in 0..MaxE
    /\ history \in Seq([w : Workers, from : 0..MaxE])
    /\ readEpoch \in [Workers -> 0..MaxE]
    /\ preparing \subseteq Workers

Init ==
    /\ epoch = 0
    /\ rec = 0
    /\ history = << >>
    /\ readEpoch = [w \in Workers |-> 0]
    /\ preparing = {}

\* A worker snapshots the current configuration epoch before proposing an update.
Snapshot(w) ==
    /\ w \notin preparing
    /\ readEpoch' = [readEpoch EXCEPT ![w] = epoch]
    /\ preparing' = preparing \cup {w}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<epoch, rec, history>>

\* Commit only if no reconfiguration intervened since the snapshot.
Commit(w) ==
    /\ w \in preparing
    /\ readEpoch[w] = epoch
    /\ epoch < MaxE
    /\ epoch' = epoch + 1
    /\ rec' = rec + 1
    /\ history' = Append(history, [w |-> w, from |-> readEpoch[w]])
    /\ preparing' = preparing \ {w}
    /\ UNCHANGED readEpoch

\* A slow worker that fell behind refreshes its snapshot to the new epoch in place.
Refresh(w) ==
    /\ w \in preparing
    /\ readEpoch[w] < epoch
    /\ readEpoch' = [readEpoch EXCEPT ![w] = epoch]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<epoch, rec, history, preparing>>

\* A worker abandons an in-flight proposal and must snapshot again later.
Abandon(w) ==
    /\ w \in preparing
    /\ preparing' = preparing \ {w}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<epoch, rec, history, readEpoch>>

Next ==
    \/ \E w \in Workers : Snapshot(w)
    \/ \E w \in Workers : Commit(w)
    \/ \E w \in Workers : Refresh(w)
    \/ \E w \in Workers : Abandon(w)

\* No lost update: every committed change was computed on top of the
\* immediately preceding version of the record, so nothing was overwritten.
NoLostUpdate ==
    \A i \in DOMAIN history : history[i].from = i - 1
====
cfg_text:
CONSTANTS
    Workers = {w1, w2}
    MaxE = 3
INIT Init
NEXT Next
INVARIANT NoLostUpdate
nl:
A car-wash conveyor line keeps a single shared record describing the active
wash program. The line is reconfigured under epoch numbers: every committed
change advances the configuration epoch by one. Before proposing a change, a
worker takes a snapshot of the current epoch (Snapshot). It may commit its
change only if no reconfiguration has intervened, that is, if the epoch it
snapshotted still equals the current epoch; the commit advances the epoch,
updates the record, and records that the change was built on the epoch it read
(Commit). A worker can be slow but never fails: a slow worker that finds itself
behind either refreshes its snapshot to the current epoch in place (Refresh) or
abandons its proposal so it can snapshot again later (Abandon).
SAFETY PROPERTY: every committed change was built on top of the immediately preceding epoch of the record, so no update silently overwrites another.

---- MODULE W4Od15m7p5t5 ----
EXTENDS Naturals

CONSTANTS Matchers

VARIABLES gen, printed, opened, reading, exp

TypeOK ==
    /\ gen \in 0..2
    /\ printed \in Matchers \cup {"admin", "unset"}
    /\ opened \in BOOLEAN
    /\ reading \subseteq Matchers
    /\ exp \in [Matchers -> 0..2]

Init ==
    /\ gen = 0
    /\ printed = "unset"
    /\ opened = FALSE
    /\ reading = {}
    /\ exp = [m \in Matchers |-> 0]

\* A matcher reads the current generation of the CAS register.
Read(m) ==
    /\ m \notin reading
    /\ reading' = reading \cup {m}
    /\ exp' = [exp EXCEPT ![m] = gen]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<gen, printed, opened>>

\* Compare-and-swap succeeds: the matcher's expected generation still matches,
\* so it performs the one irreversible print of the opening price.
CasOpen(m) ==
    /\ ~opened
    /\ m \in reading
    /\ exp[m] = gen
    /\ gen' = gen + 1
    /\ printed' = m
    /\ opened' = TRUE
    /\ reading' = reading \ {m}
    /\ UNCHANGED exp

\* Compare-and-swap fails: expectation is stale or the auction is already open.
CasFail(m) ==
    /\ m \in reading
    /\ (exp[m] # gen \/ opened)
    /\ reading' = reading \ {m}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<gen, printed, opened, exp>>

\* A privileged admin may force the opening print, still only while unopened.
AdminOverride ==
    /\ ~opened
    /\ gen' = gen + 1
    /\ printed' = "admin"
    /\ opened' = TRUE
    /\ UNCHANGED <<reading, exp>>

Next ==
    \/ \E m \in Matchers : Read(m)
    \/ \E m \in Matchers : CasOpen(m)
    \/ \E m \in Matchers : CasFail(m)
    \/ AdminOverride

\* The irreversible opening print happens at most once: once the auction is
\* opened, exactly one generation advance has occurred and a price is recorded.
FinalizedOnce ==
    opened => (gen = 1 /\ printed # "unset")
====
cfg_text:
CONSTANTS
    Matchers = {m1, m2}
INIT Init
NEXT Next
INVARIANT FinalizedOnce
nl:
A stock exchange runs an opening auction whose opening price may be printed
only once; printing the opening price is irreversible. The transition is
guarded by a single compare-and-swap register that holds a generation number.
Each competing matcher first reads the register's current generation (Read).
It then attempts a compare-and-swap: if its expected generation still matches
the register and the auction is not yet open, the swap succeeds and the matcher
performs the one irreversible opening print, advancing the generation and
recording the price (CasOpen). If a matcher's expected generation is stale, or
the auction has already opened, its compare-and-swap fails and it discards the
attempt (CasFail). A privileged exchange admin may force the opening print
directly, but still only while the auction has not yet opened (AdminOverride).
SAFETY PROPERTY: once the opening auction has been opened, exactly one generation advance has occurred and an opening price is recorded, so the irreversible print never happens twice.

spec_text:
---- MODULE W4Od16m4p4t2 ----
EXTENDS Naturals

CONSTANTS Cap

VARIABLES waitA, procA, waitB, procB

TypeOK ==
    /\ waitA \in 0..Cap
    /\ procA \in 0..Cap
    /\ waitB \in 0..Cap
    /\ procB \in 0..Cap

Load == waitA + procA + waitB + procB

Init ==
    /\ waitA = 0
    /\ procA = 0
    /\ waitB = 0
    /\ procB = 0

\* Instance A admits a prescription only if the shared pool has a free slot
\* (backpressure); otherwise the submission is refused.
SubmitA ==
    /\ Load < Cap
    /\ waitA' = waitA + 1
    /\ UNCHANGED <<procA, waitB, procB>>

SubmitB ==
    /\ Load < Cap
    /\ waitB' = waitB + 1
    /\ UNCHANGED <<waitA, procA, procB>>

\* An instance moves a queued prescription into active dispensing.
ClaimA ==
    /\ waitA > 0
    /\ waitA' = waitA - 1
    /\ procA' = procA + 1
    /\ UNCHANGED <<waitB, procB>>

ClaimB ==
    /\ waitB > 0
    /\ waitB' = waitB - 1
    /\ procB' = procB + 1
    /\ UNCHANGED <<waitA, procA>>

\* A dispensed prescription leaves the shared pool, freeing a slot.
CompleteA ==
    /\ procA > 0
    /\ procA' = procA - 1
    /\ UNCHANGED <<waitA, waitB, procB>>

CompleteB ==
    /\ procB > 0
    /\ procB' = procB - 1
    /\ UNCHANGED <<waitA, procA, waitB>>

Next ==
    \/ SubmitA \/ SubmitB
    \/ ClaimA \/ ClaimB
    \/ CompleteA \/ CompleteB

\* Bounded capacity is never exceeded: the two independent dispensers together
\* never hold more prescriptions than the shared pool's capacity.
CapacityRespected ==
    Load <= Cap
====
cfg_text:
CONSTANTS
    Cap = 4
INIT Init
NEXT Next
INVARIANT CapacityRespected
nl:
A pharmacy prescription dispenser is served by two independent dispensing
instances, A and B, that share a single bounded pool of in-progress
prescriptions. The pool applies backpressure: an instance may admit a new
prescription only when the combined load of both instances is below the pool's
capacity (SubmitA, SubmitB). Once queued, an instance moves a prescription into
active dispensing (ClaimA, ClaimB). When a prescription has been dispensed it
leaves the shared pool, freeing a slot (CompleteA, CompleteB). Because both
instances draw from and return to the same pool, admissions must account for
the other instance's outstanding work.
SAFETY PROPERTY: the two independent dispensers together never hold more prescriptions than the shared pool's capacity.

---- MODULE W4Od10m6p5t4 ----
EXTENDS Naturals, FiniteSets

CONSTANTS Blocks, Trains, MaxT, TTL

VARIABLES clock, owner, expiry, cap, sealed, sealTime

Leased == {b \in Blocks : owner[b] # "free"}

TypeOK ==
    /\ clock \in 0..MaxT
    /\ owner \in [Blocks -> Trains \cup {"free"}]
    /\ expiry \in [Blocks -> 0..(MaxT + TTL)]
    /\ cap \in 1..Cardinality(Blocks)
    /\ sealed \subseteq Blocks
    /\ sealTime \in [Blocks -> 0..MaxT]

Init ==
    /\ clock = 0
    /\ owner = [b \in Blocks |-> "free"]
    /\ expiry = [b \in Blocks |-> 0]
    /\ cap = 1
    /\ sealed = {}
    /\ sealTime = [b \in Blocks |-> 0]

\* Real time advances; leases whose expiry is in the past become reclaimable.
Tick ==
    /\ clock < MaxT
    /\ clock' = clock + 1
    /\ UNCHANGED <<owner, expiry, cap, sealed, sealTime>>

\* A train takes a lease on a free block, subject to the current capacity limit.
Acquire(b, t) ==
    /\ owner[b] = "free"
    /\ Cardinality(Leased) < cap
    /\ owner' = [owner EXCEPT ![b] = t]
    /\ expiry' = [expiry EXCEPT ![b] = clock + TTL]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<clock, cap, sealed, sealTime>>

\* A holder voluntarily gives up its lease.
Release(b) ==
    /\ owner[b] # "free"
    /\ owner' = [owner EXCEPT ![b] = "free"]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<clock, expiry, cap, sealed, sealTime>>

\* An expired lease is reclaimed once its deadline has passed.
Expire(b) ==
    /\ owner[b] # "free"
    /\ clock > expiry[b]
    /\ owner' = [owner EXCEPT ![b] = "free"]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<clock, expiry, cap, sealed, sealTime>>

\* The irreversible clear: a holder with a still-valid lease permanently seals
\* the block's movement authority. It may fire at most once per block.
Seal(b) ==
    /\ owner[b] # "free"
    /\ clock <= expiry[b]
    /\ b \notin sealed
    /\ sealed' = sealed \cup {b}
    /\ sealTime' = [sealTime EXCEPT ![b] = clock]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<clock, owner, expiry, cap>>

\* The dispatcher changes the number of blocks that may be leased at once.
SetCap ==
    /\ \E c \in 1..Cardinality(Blocks) : c # cap /\ cap' = c
    /\ UNCHANGED <<clock, owner, expiry, sealed, sealTime>>

Next ==
    \/ Tick
    \/ \E b \in Blocks, t \in Trains : Acquire(b, t)
    \/ \E b \in Blocks : Release(b)
    \/ \E b \in Blocks : Expire(b)
    \/ \E b \in Blocks : Seal(b)
    \/ SetCap

\* Every irreversible block-seal was performed while its lease was still valid:
\* the seal time never lies past the block's recorded lease expiry.
SealUnderValidLease ==
    \A b \in sealed : sealTime[b] <= expiry[b]
====
cfg_text:
CONSTANTS
    Blocks = {b1, b2}
    Trains = {t1, t2}
    MaxT = 2
    TTL = 1
INIT Init
NEXT Next
INVARIANT SealUnderValidLease
nl:
A subway signalling block system grants ownership of track blocks to trains
through leases that expire. A shared clock advances real time (Tick). A train
takes a lease on a currently free block, stamping the lease with an expiry a
fixed time-to-live in the future, but only while the number of leased blocks is
below the dispatcher's current capacity limit (Acquire). A holder may give up
its lease voluntarily (Release), and any lease whose deadline has passed may be
reclaimed (Expire). The irreversible action is sealing a block's movement
authority: a train holding a still-valid lease permanently seals the block, and
this may happen at most once per block (Seal). The dispatcher may change how
many blocks can be leased at once while the system runs (SetCap).
SAFETY PROPERTY: every irreversible block-seal was performed while its lease was still valid, so no seal is ever recorded past the block's lease expiry.

---- MODULE W4Od18m6p1t0 ----
EXTENDS Naturals

CONSTANTS Controllers, MaxE

VARIABLES holder, epoch, recEpoch, applied, snap, crashed

TypeOK ==
    /\ holder \in Controllers \cup {"none"}
    /\ epoch \in 0..MaxE
    /\ recEpoch \in 0..MaxE
    /\ applied \subseteq 0..MaxE
    /\ snap \in [Controllers -> 0..MaxE]
    /\ crashed \subseteq Controllers

Init ==
    /\ holder = "none"
    /\ epoch = 0
    /\ recEpoch = 0
    /\ applied = {}
    /\ snap = [c \in Controllers |-> 0]
    /\ crashed = {}

\* The lease is granted to a live controller under a fresh, higher epoch.
Grant(c) ==
    /\ holder = "none"
    /\ c \notin crashed
    /\ epoch < MaxE
    /\ holder' = c
    /\ epoch' = epoch + 1
    /\ UNCHANGED <<recEpoch, applied, snap, crashed>>

\* The current holder observes (snapshots) the epoch under which it holds.
Observe(c) ==
    /\ holder = c
    /\ c \notin crashed
    /\ snap' = [snap EXCEPT ![c] = epoch]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<holder, epoch, recEpoch, applied, crashed>>

\* The holder writes the shared record, but only if its snapshot is still
\* current -- an intervening re-grant would make the write a lost update.
Apply(c) ==
    /\ holder = c
    /\ c \notin crashed
    /\ snap[c] = epoch
    /\ recEpoch' = epoch
    /\ applied' = applied \cup {epoch}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<holder, epoch, snap, crashed>>

\* A controller crashes silently -- no release, no announcement.
Crash(c) ==
    /\ c \notin crashed
    /\ crashed' = crashed \cup {c}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<holder, epoch, recEpoch, applied, snap>>

\* A crashed holder's lease is reclaimed so a new epoch can be granted.
Reclaim ==
    /\ holder # "none"
    /\ holder \in crashed
    /\ holder' = "none"
    /\ UNCHANGED <<epoch, recEpoch, applied, snap, crashed>>

\* A crashed controller restarts and rejoins.
Recover(c) ==
    /\ c \in crashed
    /\ crashed' = crashed \ {c}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<holder, epoch, recEpoch, applied, snap>>

Next ==
    \/ \E c \in Controllers : Grant(c)
    \/ \E c \in Controllers : Observe(c)
    \/ \E c \in Controllers : Apply(c)
    \/ \E c \in Controllers : Crash(c)
    \/ Reclaim
    \/ \E c \in Controllers : Recover(c)

\* No lost updates: the record's stamp is at least as new as every update ever
\* applied, so no later stale write ever overwrites a newer one.
NoLostUpdate ==
    \A e \in applied : e <= recEpoch
====
cfg_text:
CONSTANTS
    Controllers = {c1, c2}
    MaxE = 3
INIT Init
NEXT Next
INVARIANT NoLostUpdate
nl:
A smart-home door-lock network keeps one shared configuration record that only
the current lease holder may write. The lease is granted to a live controller
under a fresh, strictly higher epoch (Grant). The holder first observes the
epoch under which it holds by taking a snapshot (Observe), then writes the
shared record, but only if its snapshot is still current -- if the lease was
re-granted in between, its write would be a lost update and is refused (Apply).
Any controller may crash silently, simply ceasing to act without releasing its
lease or announcing anything (Crash); a crashed holder's lease is later
reclaimed so a new epoch can be granted (Reclaim), and a crashed controller may
restart and rejoin (Recover).
SAFETY PROPERTY: the shared record's stamp is always at least as new as every update ever applied, so no later stale write overwrites a newer one.

spec_text:
---- MODULE W4Od0m6p1t1 ----
EXTENDS Naturals

CONSTANTS Schedulers, MaxG

VARIABLES lease, gen, recV, msgs, seen

Msg == [ver : 1..MaxG, by : Schedulers]

TypeOK ==
    /\ lease \in Schedulers \cup {"none"}
    /\ gen \in 0..MaxG
    /\ recV \in 0..MaxG
    /\ msgs \subseteq Msg
    /\ seen \subseteq 1..MaxG

Init ==
    /\ lease = "none"
    /\ gen = 0
    /\ recV = 0
    /\ msgs = {}
    /\ seen = {}

\* The operating-room lease is granted under a fresh, strictly higher generation.
Grant(s) ==
    /\ lease = "none"
    /\ lease' = s
    /\ gen' = IF gen < MaxG THEN gen + 1 ELSE gen
    /\ UNCHANGED <<recV, msgs, seen>>

\* The lease holder emits an update message tagged with the current generation.
\* The message joins an unordered pool and may be delivered in any order.
Send(s) ==
    /\ lease = s
    /\ msgs' = msgs \cup {[ver |-> gen, by |-> s]}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<lease, gen, recV, seen>>

\* An update is applied only if it is strictly newer than the record's current
\* version; the message is then consumed.
Deliver(m) ==
    /\ m \in msgs
    /\ m.ver > recV
    /\ recV' = m.ver
    /\ seen' = seen \cup {m.ver}
    /\ msgs' = msgs \ {m}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<lease, gen>>

\* A reordered, duplicate, or already-superseded message is discarded.
Discard(m) ==
    /\ m \in msgs
    /\ m.ver <= recV
    /\ msgs' = msgs \ {m}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<lease, gen, recV, seen>>

\* The lease is released so it can be re-granted under a new generation.
Release(s) ==
    /\ lease = s
    /\ lease' = "none"
    /\ UNCHANGED <<gen, recV, msgs, seen>>

Next ==
    \/ \E s \in Schedulers : Grant(s)
    \/ \E s \in Schedulers : Send(s)
    \/ \E m \in msgs : Deliver(m)
    \/ \E m \in msgs : Discard(m)
    \/ \E s \in Schedulers : Release(s)

\* No lost updates: despite arbitrary message reordering, the record's version
\* is at least as new as every update that was ever applied to it.
NoRegress ==
    \A v \in seen : v <= recV
====
cfg_text:
CONSTANTS
    Schedulers = {s1, s2}
    MaxG = 3
INIT Init
NEXT Next
INVARIANT NoRegress
nl:
A hospital operating-room scheduler keeps one shared record of the room's
current assignment. Write authority is held under a lease that is granted to a
scheduler under a fresh generation number that never decreases (Grant). The current
lease holder emits update messages tagged with its generation; these messages
join an unordered network pool and may be delivered in any order (Send). When a
message is delivered, its update is applied to the record only if its
generation is strictly newer than the record's current version (Deliver). A
message that has been reordered behind a newer one, or that duplicates an
already-applied update, is simply discarded (Discard). The lease may be
released so it can be re-granted under a new generation (Release).
SAFETY PROPERTY: despite arbitrary message reordering, the record's version is always at least as new as every update that was ever applied to it.

---- MODULE W4Od19m9p2t1 ----
EXTENDS Naturals, FiniteSets

CONSTANTS Total, MaxE

VARIABLES shelf, held, transit, epoch

TypeOK ==
    /\ shelf \in 0..Total
    /\ held \in 0..Total
    /\ transit \subseteq 1..Total
    /\ epoch \in 0..MaxE

Init ==
    /\ shelf = Total
    /\ held = 0
    /\ transit = {}
    /\ epoch = 0

\* A patron reserves an available copy off the shelf.
Reserve ==
    /\ shelf > 0
    /\ shelf' = shelf - 1
    /\ held' = held + 1
    /\ UNCHANGED <<transit, epoch>>

\* A held copy is returned into the delivery network as an in-transit token,
\* taking any free slot id; tokens carry no ordering.
Return ==
    /\ held > 0
    /\ \E i \in (1..Total) \ transit :
        /\ transit' = transit \cup {i}
        /\ held' = held - 1
    /\ UNCHANGED <<shelf, epoch>>

\* An in-transit copy arrives back on the shelf; any token may arrive in any
\* order, modelling reordered delivery messages.
Deliver ==
    /\ transit # {}
    /\ \E i \in transit :
        /\ transit' = transit \ {i}
        /\ shelf' = shelf + 1
    /\ UNCHANGED <<held, epoch>>

\* An epoch-numbered reconfiguration of the catalog advances the epoch.
Reconfigure ==
    /\ epoch < MaxE
    /\ epoch' = epoch + 1
    /\ UNCHANGED <<shelf, held, transit>>

Next ==
    \/ Reserve
    \/ Return
    \/ Deliver
    \/ Reconfigure

\* Conservation: every copy is always on the shelf, held on reservation, or
\* in transit -- none is ever created or destroyed.
Conservation ==
    shelf + held + Cardinality(transit) = Total
====
cfg_text:
CONSTANTS
    Total = 3
    MaxE = 3
INIT Init
NEXT Next
INVARIANT Conservation
nl:
A library book reservation system tracks a fixed number of physical copies of a
title. Each copy is always in exactly one of three places: available on the
shelf, held on reservation, or in transit through the delivery network. A
patron reserves an available copy, moving it from the shelf to held (Reserve).
A held copy is returned into the delivery network, becoming an in-transit token
that takes any free slot; these tokens carry no ordering (Return). An
in-transit copy eventually arrives back on the shelf, and because the network
messages may be reordered, any in-transit token may arrive in any order
(Deliver). Independently, the catalog undergoes epoch-numbered reconfiguration
that advances the reconfiguration epoch (Reconfigure).
SAFETY PROPERTY: every copy is always either on the shelf, held on reservation, or in transit, so the total number of copies is never created or destroyed.

spec_text:
---- MODULE W4Od11m5p0t4 ----
EXTENDS Naturals, FiniteSets

CONSTANTS Jobs, Voters, MaxCap

VARIABLES votes, active, cap, queued

TypeOK ==
    /\ votes \in [Jobs -> SUBSET Voters]
    /\ active \in Jobs \cup {"none"}
    /\ cap \in 1..MaxCap
    /\ queued \subseteq Jobs

Init ==
    /\ votes = [j \in Jobs |-> {}]
    /\ active = "none"
    /\ cap = 1
    /\ queued = {}

\* The spooler admits a job into the queue, limited by the current capacity.
Admit(j) ==
    /\ j \notin queued
    /\ Cardinality(queued) < cap
    /\ queued' = queued \cup {j}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<votes, active, cap>>

\* A voter casts its single vote for a queued job; each voter votes at most once
\* until its vote is released.
Vote(v, j) ==
    /\ j \in queued
    /\ \A k \in Jobs : v \notin votes[k]
    /\ votes' = [votes EXCEPT ![j] = votes[j] \cup {v}]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<active, cap, queued>>

\* The printer is granted to a job only once it holds a strict-majority quorum.
Grant(j) ==
    /\ j \in queued
    /\ active = "none"
    /\ Cardinality(votes[j]) * 2 > Cardinality(Voters)
    /\ active' = j
    /\ UNCHANGED <<votes, cap, queued>>

\* The job finishes printing, releasing the printer and its collected votes.
Finish(j) ==
    /\ active = j
    /\ active' = "none"
    /\ queued' = queued \ {j}
    /\ votes' = [votes EXCEPT ![j] = {}]
    /\ UNCHANGED cap

\* The spooler's queue capacity changes while the shop runs.
SetCap ==
    /\ \E c \in 1..MaxCap : c # cap /\ cap' = c
    /\ UNCHANGED <<votes, active, queued>>

Next ==
    \/ \E j \in Jobs : Admit(j)
    \/ \E v \in Voters, j \in Jobs : Vote(v, j)
    \/ \E j \in Jobs : Grant(j)
    \/ \E j \in Jobs : Finish(j)
    \/ SetCap

\* Mutual exclusion of the printer: the job holding the printer always holds a
\* strict majority of the voters, so no two jobs can hold it at once.
ActiveHasQuorum ==
    active # "none" => Cardinality(votes[active]) * 2 > Cardinality(Voters)
====

CONSTANTS
    Jobs = {j1, j2}
    Voters = {v1, v2, v3}
    MaxCap = 2
INIT Init
NEXT Next
INVARIANT ActiveHasQuorum
nl:
A print shop job spooler grants a single physical printer -- a critical
resource -- to at most one job at a time, and every grant must be approved by a
quorum vote of the spooler nodes. The spooler admits a job into its queue,
limited by the current queue capacity (Admit). Each spooler node votes at most
once, casting its single vote for a queued job until that vote is later
released (Vote). The printer is granted to a job only once the job holds a
strict majority of the nodes' votes (Grant). When the job finishes printing it
releases the printer and its collected votes so other jobs may compete
(Finish). The queue capacity may change while the shop runs (SetCap).
SAFETY PROPERTY: the job holding the printer always holds a strict majority of the voters, so no two jobs can hold the printer at once.

---- MODULE W4Od8m5p6t3 ----
EXTENDS Naturals, FiniteSets

CONSTANTS Nodes, MaxT

VARIABLES term, nodeTerm, authorized, backing, committed

TypeOK ==
    /\ term \in 0..MaxT
    /\ nodeTerm \in [Nodes -> 0..MaxT]
    /\ authorized \subseteq Nodes
    /\ backing \subseteq Nodes
    /\ committed \in BOOLEAN

Init ==
    /\ term = 0
    /\ nodeTerm = [n \in Nodes |-> 0]
    /\ authorized = Nodes
    /\ backing = {}
    /\ committed = FALSE

\* An authorized node whose term is current casts its backing for the proposal.
Vote(n) ==
    /\ n \in authorized
    /\ nodeTerm[n] = term
    /\ n \notin backing
    /\ backing' = backing \cup {n}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<term, nodeTerm, authorized, committed>>

\* The registration action commits once a strict-majority quorum backs it.
Commit ==
    /\ ~committed
    /\ Cardinality(backing) * 2 > Cardinality(Nodes)
    /\ committed' = TRUE
    /\ UNCHANGED <<term, nodeTerm, authorized, backing>>

\* A reconfiguration advances the term; any backing that is now stale (from
\* nodes not yet at the new term) is purged, and the proposal is re-opened.
AdvanceTerm ==
    /\ term < MaxT
    /\ term' = term + 1
    /\ backing' = {n \in backing : nodeTerm[n] = term + 1}
    /\ committed' = FALSE
    /\ UNCHANGED <<nodeTerm, authorized>>

\* A slow node catches up to the current term (slow, never failed).
CatchUp(n) ==
    /\ nodeTerm[n] < term
    /\ nodeTerm' = [nodeTerm EXCEPT ![n] = term]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<term, authorized, backing, committed>>

\* A node's authorization is revoked; its backing is dropped immediately.
Deauthorize(n) ==
    /\ n \in authorized
    /\ authorized' = authorized \ {n}
    /\ backing' = backing \ {n}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<term, nodeTerm, committed>>

\* An authorization is (re)granted to a node.
Authorize(n) ==
    /\ n \notin authorized
    /\ authorized' = authorized \cup {n}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<term, nodeTerm, backing, committed>>

Next ==
    \/ \E n \in Nodes : Vote(n)
    \/ Commit
    \/ AdvanceTerm
    \/ \E n \in Nodes : CatchUp(n)
    \/ \E n \in Nodes : Deauthorize(n)
    \/ \E n \in Nodes : Authorize(n)

\* No action by an unauthorized or stale participant: everyone currently backing
\* the proposal is authorized and voting in the current term.
NoStaleBacking ==
    \A n \in backing : (n \in authorized /\ nodeTerm[n] = term)
====
cfg_text:
CONSTANTS
    Nodes = {n1, n2, n3}
    MaxT = 2
INIT Init
NEXT Next
INVARIANT NoStaleBacking
nl:
A university course-registration system commits each seat-allocation action
only after a quorum of registrar nodes has voted for it. Each action carries a
term number. An authorized node whose local term is current casts its backing
for the proposal (Vote), and the action commits once a strict majority of nodes
is backing it (Commit). A reconfiguration advances the term; because nodes that
have not yet caught up are now stale, their backing is purged and the proposal
is re-opened (AdvanceTerm). A node can be slow but never fails: a lagging node
eventually catches up to the current term (CatchUp). A node's authorization may
be revoked, in which case its backing is dropped immediately (Deauthorize), and
authorization may later be granted again (Authorize).
SAFETY PROPERTY: everyone currently backing the proposal is an authorized node voting in the current term, so no unauthorized or stale participant ever contributes to an action.

with failover when the leader is lost. A new leader is elected under a fresh
term, and any prior action records are cleared (Elect). Only the node that is
the leader of the current term may perform a routing action (Act). The current
leader may fail over, leaving leadership vacant until a new election (Failover).
A privileged operations admin may forcibly install a leader under a fresh term,
overriding the normal election (AdminOverride). In every case a change of
leadership clears the record of who has acted, so a superseded leader from an
old term can never continue to act.

---- MODULE W4Od6m0p0t3 ----
EXTENDS Naturals

CONSTANTS Cars, MaxV

VARIABLES ver, owner, snap, reading, inLane

TypeOK ==
    /\ ver \in 0..MaxV
    /\ owner \in Cars \cup {"free"}
    /\ snap \in [Cars -> 0..MaxV]
    /\ reading \subseteq Cars
    /\ inLane \subseteq Cars

Init ==
    /\ ver = 0
    /\ owner = "free"
    /\ snap = [c \in Cars |-> 0]
    /\ reading = {}
    /\ inLane = {}

\* A car optimistically reads the lane lock's version before trying to claim it.
Read(c) ==
    /\ c \notin reading
    /\ c \notin inLane
    /\ snap' = [snap EXCEPT ![c] = ver]
    /\ reading' = reading \cup {c}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<ver, owner, inLane>>

\* Compare-and-swap on the version succeeds only if nothing changed since the
\* read and the lane is free; the car enters and bumps the version.
Acquire(c) ==
    /\ c \in reading
    /\ owner = "free"
    /\ snap[c] = ver
    /\ owner' = c
    /\ ver' = IF ver < MaxV THEN ver + 1 ELSE ver
    /\ inLane' = inLane \cup {c}
    /\ reading' = reading \ {c}
    /\ UNCHANGED snap

\* The optimistic check failed (lane busy or version moved); the car retries by
\* dropping back so it can read again. A slow car simply retries until it wins.
Retry(c) ==
    /\ c \in reading
    /\ (owner # "free" \/ snap[c] # ver)
    /\ reading' = reading \ {c}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<ver, owner, snap, inLane>>

\* The car leaves the lane, freeing the lock and bumping the version.
Release(c) ==
    /\ c \in inLane
    /\ owner' = "free"
    /\ inLane' = inLane \ {c}
    /\ ver' = IF ver < MaxV THEN ver + 1 ELSE ver
    /\ UNCHANGED <<snap, reading>>

Next ==
    \/ \E c \in Cars : Read(c)
    \/ \E c \in Cars : Acquire(c)
    \/ \E c \in Cars : Retry(c)
    \/ \E c \in Cars : Release(c)

\* Mutual exclusion of the shared lane: any car in the lane is the recorded lock
\* owner, so at most one car occupies the critical lane at a time.
MutualExclusion ==
    \A c \in inLane : owner = c
====
cfg_text:
CONSTANTS
    Cars = {c1, c2}
    MaxV = 2
INIT Init
NEXT Next
INVARIANT MutualExclusion
nl:
An elevator bank in a skyscraper shares a single express lane that only one car
may occupy at a time -- the critical resource. Cars coordinate with an
optimistic lock carrying a version number. A car first reads the lock's current
version before trying to claim the lane (Read). It then attempts a
compare-and-swap: the claim succeeds only if the lane is free and the version
has not changed since the read, at which point the car enters the lane and
bumps the version (Acquire). If the optimistic check fails -- the lane is busy
or the version moved -- the car retries by dropping back to read again; a car
can be slow but never fails, so it simply keeps retrying until it wins (Retry).
When a car leaves the lane it frees the lock and bumps the version (Release).
SAFETY PROPERTY: any car in the express lane is the recorded lock owner, so at most one car ever occupies the critical lane at a time.

---- MODULE W4Od4m8p3t1 ----
EXTENDS Naturals

CONSTANTS Cars, Zones, Slots

ZoneOf(s) == IF s <= 2 THEN 1 ELSE 2

VARIABLES zoneLock, slotLock, coarseReq, fineReq

TypeOK ==
    /\ zoneLock \in [Zones -> Cars \cup {"free"}]
    /\ slotLock \in [Slots -> Cars \cup {"free"}]
    /\ coarseReq \subseteq [c : Cars, z : Zones]
    /\ fineReq \subseteq [c : Cars, s : Slots]

Init ==
    /\ zoneLock = [z \in Zones |-> "free"]
    /\ slotLock = [s \in Slots |-> "free"]
    /\ coarseReq = {}
    /\ fineReq = {}

\* A car posts a coarse zone-lock request into the unordered request pool.
ReqCoarse(c, z) ==
    /\ [c |-> c, z |-> z] \notin coarseReq
    /\ coarseReq' = coarseReq \cup {[c |-> c, z |-> z]}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<zoneLock, slotLock, fineReq>>

\* A coarse request is served in any order if its zone lock is free.
GrantCoarse(m) ==
    /\ m \in coarseReq
    /\ zoneLock[m.z] = "free"
    /\ zoneLock' = [zoneLock EXCEPT ![m.z] = m.c]
    /\ coarseReq' = coarseReq \ {m}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<slotLock, fineReq>>

\* A car posts a fine slot-lock request into the unordered request pool.
ReqFine(c, s) ==
    /\ [c |-> c, s |-> s] \notin fineReq
    /\ fineReq' = fineReq \cup {[c |-> c, s |-> s]}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<zoneLock, slotLock, coarseReq>>

\* A fine request is served only if the car already holds the enclosing coarse
\* zone lock and the slot is free -- the hierarchy is respected despite ordering.
GrantFine(m) ==
    /\ m \in fineReq
    /\ zoneLock[ZoneOf(m.s)] = m.c
    /\ slotLock[m.s] = "free"
    /\ slotLock' = [slotLock EXCEPT ![m.s] = m.c]
    /\ fineReq' = fineReq \ {m}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<zoneLock, coarseReq>>

\* A car releases a slot it holds.
ReleaseFine(s) ==
    /\ slotLock[s] # "free"
    /\ slotLock' = [slotLock EXCEPT ![s] = "free"]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<zoneLock, coarseReq, fineReq>>

\* A car releases a zone lock, but only once it holds no slots in that zone.
ReleaseCoarse(z) ==
    /\ zoneLock[z] # "free"
    /\ \A s \in Slots : ZoneOf(s) = z => slotLock[s] = "free"
    /\ zoneLock' = [zoneLock EXCEPT ![z] = "free"]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<slotLock, coarseReq, fineReq>>

Next ==
    \/ \E c \in Cars, z \in Zones : ReqCoarse(c, z)
    \/ \E m \in coarseReq : GrantCoarse(m)
    \/ \E c \in Cars, s \in Slots : ReqFine(c, s)
    \/ \E m \in fineReq : GrantFine(m)
    \/ \E s \in Slots : ReleaseFine(s)
    \/ \E z \in Zones : ReleaseCoarse(z)

\* No double allocation: a wash slot is allocated only to the car that holds the
\* coarse zone lock covering it, so two cars can never both claim the same slot.
NoDoubleAlloc ==
    \A s \in Slots : slotLock[s] # "free" => zoneLock[ZoneOf(s)] = slotLock[s]
====
nl:
A car-wash conveyor line allocates wash slots using a two-level hierarchical
lock: a car must hold the coarse lock on a slot's zone before it may hold the
fine lock on the slot itself. Requests travel over an unordered network, so
coarse and fine lock requests sit in request pools and are served in any order.
A car posts a coarse zone-lock request (ReqCoarse), which is granted in any
order when the zone lock is free (GrantCoarse). A car posts a fine slot-lock
request (ReqFine), which is granted only if the car already holds the enclosing
coarse zone lock and the slot is free (GrantFine). A car releases a slot it
holds (ReleaseFine), and releases a zone lock only once it holds no slots in
that zone (ReleaseCoarse).
SAFETY PROPERTY: a wash slot is allocated only to the car that holds the coarse zone lock covering it, so two cars can never both claim the same slot.

---- MODULE W4Od0m3p0t5 ----
EXTENDS Naturals

CONSTANTS Teams, MaxT

VARIABLES term, leader, occupying, candidates

TypeOK ==
    /\ term \in 0..MaxT
    /\ leader \in Teams \cup {"none"}
    /\ occupying \subseteq Teams
    /\ candidates \subseteq Teams

Init ==
    /\ term = 0
    /\ leader = "none"
    /\ occupying = {}
    /\ candidates = {}

\* A surgical team declares candidacy for the current leadership term.
Declare(t) ==
    /\ t \notin candidates
    /\ candidates' = candidates \cup {t}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<term, leader, occupying>>

\* A leader is elected from the declared candidates under a fresh term.
Elect(t) ==
    /\ leader = "none"
    /\ t \in candidates
    /\ leader' = t
    /\ term' = IF term < MaxT THEN term + 1 ELSE term
    /\ candidates' = {}
    /\ UNCHANGED occupying

\* Only the current leader may enter the operating room, and only when it is
\* empty -- the room admits one team at a time.
Enter(t) ==
    /\ leader = t
    /\ occupying = {}
    /\ occupying' = {t}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<term, leader, candidates>>

\* The occupying team leaves the operating room.
Leave(t) ==
    /\ t \in occupying
    /\ occupying' = occupying \ {t}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<term, leader, candidates>>

\* The leader fails over; the room is vacated and leadership becomes open.
Failover ==
    /\ leader # "none"
    /\ leader' = "none"
    /\ occupying' = {}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<term, candidates>>

\* A privileged admin forcibly installs a leader, vacating the room.
AdminOverride(t) ==
    /\ leader' = t
    /\ term' = IF term < MaxT THEN term + 1 ELSE term
    /\ occupying' = {}
    /\ candidates' = {}

Next ==
    \/ \E t \in Teams : Declare(t)
    \/ \E t \in Teams : Elect(t)
    \/ \E t \in Teams : Enter(t)
    \/ \E t \in Teams : Leave(t)
    \/ Failover
    \/ \E t \in Teams : AdminOverride(t)

\* Mutual exclusion of the operating room: any team occupying the room is the
\* current leader, so at most one team is ever in the room.
MutualExclusion ==
    \A t \in occupying : t = leader
====

NEXT Next

one operating room, with failover if the leader is lost. A surgical team
declares candidacy for the current term (Declare), and a leader is elected from
the declared candidates under a fresh term (Elect). Only the current leader may
enter the operating room, and only while it is empty, since the room admits one
team at a time (Enter). The occupying team later leaves the room (Leave). If the
leader fails over, the room is vacated and leadership becomes open again
(Failover). A privileged admin may forcibly install a leader, which also vacates
the room (AdminOverride).
SAFETY PROPERTY: any team occupying the operating room is the current leader, so at most one team is ever in the room at a time.

---- MODULE W4Od1m5p3t4 ----
EXTENDS Naturals, FiniteSets

CONSTANTS Slots, Flights, Voters

VARIABLES alloc, pend, cap, attempts

Approvers(s, f) == {v \in Voters : [s |-> s, f |-> f, v |-> v] \in pend}
Used == {s \in Slots : alloc[s] # "free"}

TypeOK ==
    /\ alloc \in [Slots -> Flights \cup {"free"}]
    /\ pend \subseteq [s : Slots, f : Flights, v : Voters]
    /\ cap \in 0..Cardinality(Slots)
    /\ attempts \subseteq [s : Slots, f : Flights]

Init ==
    /\ alloc = [s \in Slots |-> "free"]
    /\ pend = {}
    /\ cap = 1
    /\ attempts = {}

\* A flight declares an attempt to claim a runway slot.
Attempt(s, f) ==
    /\ [s |-> s, f |-> f] \notin attempts
    /\ attempts' = attempts \cup {[s |-> s, f |-> f]}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<alloc, pend, cap>>

\* A controller approves an attempt, voting at most once per slot.
Approve(s, f, v) ==
    /\ [s |-> s, f |-> f] \in attempts
    /\ \A g \in Flights : [s |-> s, f |-> g, v |-> v] \notin pend
    /\ pend' = pend \cup {[s |-> s, f |-> f, v |-> v]}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<alloc, cap, attempts>>

\* A slot is allocated to a flight only once that flight holds a strict-majority
\* quorum of approvals, the slot is free, and capacity permits.
Allocate(s, f) ==
    /\ alloc[s] = "free"
    /\ Cardinality(Approvers(s, f)) * 2 > Cardinality(Voters)
    /\ Cardinality(Used) < cap
    /\ alloc' = [alloc EXCEPT ![s] = f]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<pend, cap, attempts>>

\* A slot is released, clearing its allocation, approvals, and attempts.
Release(s) ==
    /\ alloc[s] # "free"
    /\ alloc' = [alloc EXCEPT ![s] = "free"]
    /\ pend' = {m \in pend : m.s # s}
    /\ attempts' = {a \in attempts : a.s # s}
    /\ UNCHANGED cap

\* The allocator's concurrent-allocation capacity changes at runtime.
SetCap ==
    /\ \E c \in 0..Cardinality(Slots) : c # cap /\ cap' = c
    /\ UNCHANGED <<alloc, pend, attempts>>

Next ==
    \/ \E s \in Slots, f \in Flights : Attempt(s, f)
    \/ \E s \in Slots, f \in Flights, v \in Voters : Approve(s, f, v)
    \/ \E s \in Slots, f \in Flights : Allocate(s, f)
    \/ \E s \in Slots : Release(s)
    \/ SetCap

\* No double allocation of the same slot: any allocated slot's flight holds a
\* strict majority of the controllers' approvals for that slot, and since a
\* controller approves at most one flight per slot, no two flights can win it.
NoDoubleAlloc ==
    \A s \in Slots :
        alloc[s] # "free" => Cardinality(Approvers(s, alloc[s])) * 2 > Cardinality(Voters)
====
nl:
An air-traffic runway allocator assigns runway time-slots to flights, and every
allocation must be approved by a quorum vote of the controllers. A flight first
declares an attempt to claim a slot (Attempt). Each controller approves an
attempt, casting at most one approval per slot (Approve). A slot is allocated to
a flight only once that flight holds a strict majority of the controllers'
approvals for the slot, the slot is currently free, and the allocator's
capacity permits another concurrent allocation (Allocate). A slot may be
released, clearing its allocation, approvals, and attempts (Release). The
allocator's concurrent-allocation capacity changes while the system runs
(SetCap).
SAFETY PROPERTY: any allocated slot's flight holds a strict majority of the controllers' approvals for that slot, and since each controller approves at most one flight per slot, no two flights can ever be allocated the same slot.

    /\ lead \in Nodes \cup {"none"}
    /\ issued \in [Nodes -> 0..MaxA]
    /\ cap \in 0..MaxA

    /\ gterm = 0
    /\ lead = "none"
    /\ issued = [n \in Nodes |-> 0]

Elect(n) ==

    /\ lead' = n
    /\ gterm' = IF gterm < MaxT THEN gterm + 1 ELSE gterm
    /\ issued' = [m \in Nodes |-> 0]
    /\ UNCHANGED cap

Issue(n) ==
    /\ lead = n
    /\ issued[n] < cap
    /\ issued' = [issued EXCEPT ![n] = issued[n] + 1]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<gterm, lead, cap>>

    /\ lead # "none"
    /\ lead' = "none"
    /\ issued' = [m \in Nodes |-> 0]

    \/ \E n \in Nodes : Issue(n)
    \/ Failover
    \/ SetCap

under a fresh term, and the per-term action counts are reset (Elect). Only the
current leader may issue a scheduling action, and only up to the scheduler's
current per-term capacity (Issue). When the leader fails over, leadership
becomes vacant and the action counts reset again (Failover). The per-term action
capacity may change while the scheduler runs (SetCap). Because every change of
leadership resets the record of who has issued actions, a superseded node from
an earlier term can never appear to have acted.
SAFETY PROPERTY: any node that has issued an action in the current term is the current leader itself, so no unauthorized or stale participant ever issues a scheduling action.

---- MODULE W4Od3m6p2t5 ----
EXTENDS Naturals

CONSTANTS Agents, Total, MaxT, TTL

VARIABLES clock, holder, expiry, balA, balB

    /\ clock \in 0..MaxT
    /\ holder \in Agents \cup {"none"}
    /\ expiry \in 0..(MaxT + TTL)
    /\ balA \in 0..Total
    /\ balB \in 0..Total

    /\ clock = 0
    /\ holder = "none"
    /\ expiry = 0
    /\ balA = Total
    /\ balB = 0

\* Real time advances, moving leases toward expiry.
Tick ==
    /\ clock < MaxT
    /\ clock' = clock + 1
    /\ UNCHANGED <<holder, expiry, balA, balB>>

\* A settlement agent takes the transfer lease with a fresh expiry.
Acquire(a) ==
    /\ holder = "none"
    /\ holder' = a
    /\ expiry' = clock + TTL
    /\ UNCHANGED <<clock, balA, balB>>

\* The lease holder settles one unit from account A to account B.
SettleAB ==
    /\ holder # "none"
    /\ clock <= expiry
    /\ balA > 0
    /\ balA' = balA - 1
    /\ balB' = balB + 1
    /\ UNCHANGED <<clock, holder, expiry>>

\* The lease holder settles one unit from account B to account A.
SettleBA ==
    /\ holder # "none"
    /\ clock <= expiry
    /\ balB > 0
    /\ balB' = balB - 1
    /\ balA' = balA + 1
    /\ UNCHANGED <<clock, holder, expiry>>

\* An expired lease is reclaimed.
Expire ==
    /\ holder # "none"
    /\ clock > expiry
    /\ holder' = "none"
    /\ UNCHANGED <<clock, expiry, balA, balB>>

\* A privileged admin forcibly reassigns the settlement lease.
AdminOverride(a) ==
    /\ holder' = a
    /\ expiry' = clock + TTL
    /\ UNCHANGED <<clock, balA, balB>>

Next ==
    \/ Tick
    \/ \E a \in Agents : Acquire(a)
    \/ SettleAB
    \/ SettleBA
    \/ Expire
    \/ \E a \in Agents : AdminOverride(a)

\* Conservation: interbank settlement only moves funds between the two accounts;
\* the total balance is never created or destroyed.
Conservation ==
    balA + balB = Total
====

    Agents = {a1, a2}
    Total = 3
    MaxT = 2
    TTL = 1
INIT Init
NEXT Next
INVARIANT Conservation
nl:
A bank's interbank settlement batch moves funds between two settlement accounts
under a lease that grants transfer authority and expires. A shared clock
advances real time (Tick). A settlement agent takes the transfer lease with a
fresh expiry a fixed time-to-live ahead (Acquire). While holding a still-valid
lease, the agent settles one unit from account A to account B (SettleAB) or one
unit from account B to account A (SettleBA); every settlement only moves funds
between the accounts. An expired lease is reclaimed (Expire), and a privileged
bank admin may forcibly reassign the settlement lease at any time
(AdminOverride).
SAFETY PROPERTY: interbank settlement only moves funds between the two accounts, so the total balance is never created or destroyed.

---- MODULE W4Od14m4p1t4 ----
EXTENDS Naturals, Sequences

CONSTANTS MaxId, MaxCap

VARIABLES inq, cap, nextId, rec, pressured

TypeOK ==
    /\ inq \in Seq(1..MaxId)
    /\ cap \in 1..MaxCap
    /\ nextId \in 0..MaxId
    /\ rec \in Seq(1..MaxId)
    /\ pressured \in BOOLEAN

Init ==
    /\ inq = << >>
    /\ cap = 1
    /\ nextId = 0
    /\ rec = << >>
    /\ pressured = FALSE

\* A drone enqueues its next observation, but only while the bounded queue has
\* room -- backpressure blocks enqueue once the queue is full.
Enqueue ==
    /\ Len(inq) < cap
    /\ nextId < MaxId
    /\ nextId' = nextId + 1
    /\ inq' = Append(inq, nextId + 1)
    /\ UNCHANGED <<cap, rec, pressured>>

\* The fuser applies the head observation to the shared record, in queue order.
Apply ==
    /\ inq # << >>
    /\ rec' = Append(rec, Head(inq))
    /\ inq' = Tail(inq)
    /\ UNCHANGED <<cap, nextId, pressured>>

\* The queue capacity changes while the swarm runs.
SetCap ==
    /\ \E c \in 1..MaxCap : c # cap /\ cap' = c
    /\ UNCHANGED <<inq, nextId, rec, pressured>>

\* The backpressure indicator is updated to reflect whether the queue is full.
UpdatePressure ==
    /\ pressured # (Len(inq) >= cap)
    /\ pressured' = (Len(inq) >= cap)
    /\ UNCHANGED <<inq, cap, nextId, rec>>

Next ==
    \/ Enqueue
    \/ Apply
    \/ SetCap
    \/ UpdatePressure

\* No lost updates: the shared record is exactly the contiguous prefix of
\* observations 1, 2, 3, ... in order, so no observation is ever dropped,
\* duplicated, or reordered.
NoLostUpdate ==
    \A i \in DOMAIN rec : rec[i] = i
====

    MaxId = 3
    MaxCap = 2
INIT Init
NEXT Next

that a fuser applies, in order, to a shared record (the fused fire map). A drone
enqueues its next sequentially numbered observation, but only while the bounded
queue has room; once the queue is full, backpressure blocks further enqueues
(Enqueue). The fuser applies the head observation of the queue to the shared
record, always in queue order (Apply). The queue's capacity may change while the
swarm operates (SetCap), and a backpressure indicator is updated to reflect
whether the queue is currently full (UpdatePressure).
SAFETY PROPERTY: the shared record is exactly the contiguous prefix of observations 1, 2, 3, ... in order, so no observation is ever dropped, duplicated, or reordered.

---- MODULE W4Od8m4p5t0 ----
EXTENDS Naturals, Sequences

CONSTANTS Students, Cap, MaxSeat

VARIABLES reqQ, enrolled, seat, nextSeat, crashed

InQueue(s) == \E i \in DOMAIN reqQ : reqQ[i] = s

TypeOK ==
    /\ reqQ \in Seq(Students)
    /\ enrolled \subseteq Students
    /\ seat \in [Students -> 0..MaxSeat]
    /\ nextSeat \in 1..MaxSeat
    /\ crashed \in BOOLEAN

Init ==
    /\ reqQ = << >>
    /\ enrolled = {}
    /\ seat = [s \in Students |-> 0]
    /\ nextSeat = 1
    /\ crashed = FALSE

\* A student submits an enrollment request into the bounded queue, but only if
\* not already enrolled or waiting, and only while the queue has room.
Submit(s) ==
    /\ s \notin enrolled
    /\ ~InQueue(s)
    /\ Len(reqQ) < Cap
    /\ reqQ' = Append(reqQ, s)
    /\ UNCHANGED <<enrolled, seat, nextSeat, crashed>>

\* The registrar irreversibly enrolls the head student and assigns a seat. This
\* happens at most once per student.
Enroll ==
    /\ ~crashed
    /\ reqQ # << >>
    /\ Head(reqQ) \notin enrolled
    /\ enrolled' = enrolled \cup {Head(reqQ)}
    /\ seat' = [seat EXCEPT ![Head(reqQ)] = nextSeat]
    /\ nextSeat' = IF nextSeat < MaxSeat THEN nextSeat + 1 ELSE nextSeat
    /\ reqQ' = Tail(reqQ)
    /\ UNCHANGED crashed

\* The registrar worker crashes silently.
Crash ==
    /\ ~crashed
    /\ crashed' = TRUE
    /\ UNCHANGED <<reqQ, enrolled, seat, nextSeat>>

\* The registrar worker restarts.
Recover ==
    /\ crashed
    /\ crashed' = FALSE
    /\ UNCHANGED <<reqQ, enrolled, seat, nextSeat>>

Next ==
    \/ \E s \in Students : Submit(s)
    \/ Enroll
    \/ Crash
    \/ Recover

\* The irreversible enrollment happens at most once per student: once a student
\* is enrolled, they are never again waiting in the enrollment queue.
EnrolledNeverRequeued ==
    \A s \in enrolled : ~InQueue(s)
====
cfg_text:
CONSTANTS
    Students = {s1, s2, s3}
    Cap = 2
    MaxSeat = 3
INIT Init
NEXT Next
INVARIANT EnrolledNeverRequeued
nl:
A university course-registration system processes enrollment through a bounded
work queue with backpressure. A student submits an enrollment request into the
queue, but only if not already enrolled or already waiting, and only while the
queue has room below its capacity (Submit). The registrar irreversibly enrolls
the student at the head of the queue and assigns them a seat; this enrollment is
the irreversible action and happens at most once per student (Enroll). The
registrar worker can crash silently, ceasing to process the queue without
warning (Crash), and later restart (Recover).
SAFETY PROPERTY: once a student has been irreversibly enrolled, they are never again waiting in the enrollment queue, so the irreversible enrollment can never happen to the same student twice.

---- MODULE W4Od19m3p2t3 ----
EXTENDS Naturals

CONSTANTS Nodes, Total

VARIABLES leader, shelf, reserved, transit, seenLeader

TypeOK ==
    /\ leader \in Nodes \cup {"none"}
    /\ shelf \in 0..Total
    /\ reserved \in 0..Total
    /\ transit \in 0..Total
    /\ seenLeader \in [Nodes -> Nodes \cup {"none"}]

Init ==
    /\ leader = "none"
    /\ shelf = Total
    /\ reserved = 0
    /\ transit = 0
    /\ seenLeader = [n \in Nodes |-> "none"]

\* A coordinator is elected when there is no leader.
Elect(n) ==
    /\ leader = "none"
    /\ leader' = n
    /\ UNCHANGED <<shelf, reserved, transit, seenLeader>>

\* The leader coordinates reserving a copy off the shelf.
Reserve ==
    /\ leader # "none"
    /\ shelf > 0
    /\ shelf' = shelf - 1
    /\ reserved' = reserved + 1
    /\ UNCHANGED <<leader, transit, seenLeader>>

\* A reserved copy is shipped into the delivery network.
Ship ==
    /\ leader # "none"
    /\ reserved > 0
    /\ reserved' = reserved - 1
    /\ transit' = transit + 1
    /\ UNCHANGED <<leader, shelf, seenLeader>>

\* An in-transit copy is delivered back to the shelf.
Deliver ==
    /\ leader # "none"
    /\ transit > 0
    /\ transit' = transit - 1
    /\ shelf' = shelf + 1
    /\ UNCHANGED <<leader, reserved, seenLeader>>

\* The current leader fails over; leadership becomes vacant.
Failover ==
    /\ leader # "none"
    /\ leader' = "none"
    /\ UNCHANGED <<shelf, reserved, transit, seenLeader>>

\* A slow follower catches up to the current leader; it lags but never fails.
CatchUp(n) ==
    /\ seenLeader[n] # leader
    /\ seenLeader' = [seenLeader EXCEPT ![n] = leader]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<leader, shelf, reserved, transit>>

Next ==
    \/ \E n \in Nodes : Elect(n)
    \/ Reserve
    \/ Ship
    \/ Deliver
    \/ Failover
    \/ \E n \in Nodes : CatchUp(n)

\* Conservation: every copy is always on the shelf, reserved, or in transit;
\* none is ever created or destroyed regardless of leadership changes.
Conservation ==
    shelf + reserved + transit = Total
====
cfg_text:
CONSTANTS
    Nodes = {n1, n2}
    Total = 3
INIT Init
NEXT Next
INVARIANT Conservation
nl:
A library book reservation system tracks a fixed number of copies of a title
and elects a single coordinator node to sequence the copies' movements, with
failover if the coordinator is lost. A coordinator is elected whenever there is
no leader (Elect). Under the leader's coordination, a copy is reserved off the
shelf (Reserve), a reserved copy is shipped into the delivery network (Ship),
and an in-transit copy is delivered back to the shelf (Deliver). The current
leader may fail over, leaving leadership vacant (Failover). A follower node can
be slow but never fails: a lagging follower eventually catches up to the current
leader (CatchUp).
SAFETY PROPERTY: every copy is always on the shelf, reserved, or in transit, so the total number of copies is never created or destroyed regardless of leadership changes.

---- MODULE W4Od19m0p0t2 ----
EXTENDS Naturals

CONSTANTS Instances, MaxV

VARIABLES lockOwner, ver, rd, pc

TypeOK ==
    /\ lockOwner \in Instances \cup {"free"}
    /\ ver \in 0..MaxV
    /\ rd \in [Instances -> 0..MaxV]
    /\ pc \in [Instances -> {"idle", "acquiring", "critical"}]

Init ==
    /\ lockOwner = "free"
    /\ ver = 0
    /\ rd = [i \in Instances |-> 0]
    /\ pc = [i \in Instances |-> "idle"]

\* A branch instance optimistically reads the shared ledger's version.
Read(i) ==
    /\ pc[i] = "idle"
    /\ rd' = [rd EXCEPT ![i] = ver]
    /\ pc' = [pc EXCEPT ![i] = "acquiring"]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<lockOwner, ver>>

\* Compare-and-swap succeeds: the lock is free and the version is unchanged, so
\* the instance enters the critical section over the shared reservation ledger.
Acquire(i) ==
    /\ pc[i] = "acquiring"
    /\ lockOwner = "free"
    /\ rd[i] = ver
    /\ lockOwner' = i
    /\ pc' = [pc EXCEPT ![i] = "critical"]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<ver, rd>>

\* The optimistic check failed (lock taken or version moved); the instance
\* retries from idle.
Retry(i) ==
    /\ pc[i] = "acquiring"
    /\ (lockOwner # "free" \/ rd[i] # ver)
    /\ pc' = [pc EXCEPT ![i] = "idle"]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<lockOwner, ver, rd>>

\* The instance leaves the critical section, freeing the lock and bumping the
\* shared version.
Exit(i) ==
    /\ pc[i] = "critical"
    /\ lockOwner' = "free"
    /\ pc' = [pc EXCEPT ![i] = "idle"]
    /\ ver' = IF ver < MaxV THEN ver + 1 ELSE ver
    /\ UNCHANGED rd

Next ==
    \/ \E i \in Instances : Read(i)
    \/ \E i \in Instances : Acquire(i)
    \/ \E i \in Instances : Retry(i)
    \/ \E i \in Instances : Exit(i)

\* Mutual exclusion: an instance is in the critical section over the shared
\* reservation ledger only if it holds the lock, so the two independent
\* instances never edit the shared pool at the same time.
MutEx ==
    \A i \in Instances : pc[i] = "critical" => lockOwner = i
====
cfg_text:
CONSTANTS
    Instances = {inst1, inst2}
    MaxV = 2
INIT Init
NEXT Next
INVARIANT MutEx
nl:
A library book reservation system runs two independent branch instances that
share one reservation ledger -- a critical resource that only one instance may
edit at a time. The instances coordinate with an optimistic lock carrying a
version number. A branch instance first optimistically reads the ledger's
current version (Read). It then attempts a compare-and-swap: the claim succeeds
only if the lock is free and the version has not changed since the read, at
which point the instance enters the critical section (Acquire). If the check
fails -- the lock is taken or the version moved -- the instance retries from the
start (Retry). When an instance leaves the critical section it frees the lock
and bumps the shared version (Exit).
SAFETY PROPERTY: an instance edits the shared reservation ledger only while it holds the lock, so the two independent instances never edit the shared pool at the same time.

---- MODULE W4Od12m9p1t2 ----
EXTENDS Naturals

CONSTANTS Instances, MaxE, MaxC

VARIABLES epoch, rec, committed, snap, prep

TypeOK ==
    /\ epoch \in 0..MaxE
    /\ rec \in [Instances -> 0..MaxC]
    /\ committed \in [Instances -> 0..MaxC]
    /\ snap \in [Instances -> 0..MaxE]
    /\ prep \subseteq Instances

Init ==
    /\ epoch = 0
    /\ rec = [i \in Instances |-> 0]
    /\ committed = [i \in Instances |-> 0]
    /\ snap = [i \in Instances |-> 0]
    /\ prep = {}

\* The inventory pool undergoes an epoch-numbered reconfiguration.
Reconfigure ==
    /\ epoch < MaxE
    /\ epoch' = epoch + 1
    /\ UNCHANGED <<rec, committed, snap, prep>>

\* An instance snapshots the current epoch before preparing an update.
Prepare(i) ==
    /\ i \notin prep
    /\ snap' = [snap EXCEPT ![i] = epoch]
    /\ prep' = prep \cup {i}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<epoch, rec, committed>>

\* An instance commits its update to the shared pool only if no reconfiguration
\* intervened; the commit atomically records it in the shared record.
Commit(i) ==
    /\ i \in prep
    /\ snap[i] = epoch
    /\ committed[i] < MaxC
    /\ committed' = [committed EXCEPT ![i] = committed[i] + 1]
    /\ rec' = [rec EXCEPT ![i] = rec[i] + 1]
    /\ prep' = prep \ {i}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<epoch, snap>>

\* An instance abandons an in-flight update (e.g. after a reconfiguration).
Abort(i) ==
    /\ i \in prep
    /\ prep' = prep \ {i}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<epoch, rec, committed, snap>>

Next ==
    \/ Reconfigure
    \/ \E i \in Instances : Prepare(i)
    \/ \E i \in Instances : Commit(i)
    \/ \E i \in Instances : Abort(i)

\* No lost updates: for each of the two instances sharing the pool, the shared
\* record reflects exactly its committed updates -- none is lost or clobbered.
NoLostUpdate ==
    \A i \in Instances : rec[i] = committed[i]
====
cfg_text:
CONSTANTS
    Instances = {i1, i2}
    MaxE = 2
    MaxC = 2
INIT Init
NEXT Next
INVARIANT NoLostUpdate
nl:
A blood-bank inventory tracker is served by two independent instances that share
one inventory pool recorded in a single shared record. The pool is reconfigured
under epoch numbers (Reconfigure). Before preparing an update, an instance
snapshots the current epoch (Prepare). It may commit its update to the shared
pool only if no reconfiguration has intervened since its snapshot -- that is, if
its snapshotted epoch still equals the current epoch; the commit atomically
records the update in the shared record (Commit). If a reconfiguration
intervenes, the instance abandons its in-flight update (Abort). Because both
instances write into the same shared record, a commit that failed to record
would be a lost update.
SAFETY PROPERTY: for each of the two instances sharing the pool, the shared record reflects exactly its committed updates, so no update is ever lost or clobbered.

---- MODULE W4Od2m4p2t0 ----
EXTENDS Naturals

CONSTANTS Total, Cap

VARIABLES inbound, queue, delivered, crashed

TypeOK ==
    /\ inbound \in 0..Total
    /\ queue \in 0..Cap
    /\ delivered \in 0..Total
    /\ crashed \in BOOLEAN

Init ==
    /\ inbound = Total
    /\ queue = 0
    /\ delivered = 0
    /\ crashed = FALSE

\* A robot moves a package into the bounded staging queue, but only while the
\* queue has room -- backpressure blocks pickup once the queue is full.
Pickup ==
    /\ ~crashed
    /\ inbound > 0
    /\ queue < Cap
    /\ inbound' = inbound - 1
    /\ queue' = queue + 1
    /\ UNCHANGED <<delivered, crashed>>

\* A robot delivers a package out of the staging queue.
Deliver ==
    /\ ~crashed
    /\ queue > 0
    /\ queue' = queue - 1
    /\ delivered' = delivered + 1
    /\ UNCHANGED <<inbound, crashed>>

\* A delivered package is returned to the inbound pool for another cycle.
Return ==
    /\ delivered > 0
    /\ delivered' = delivered - 1
    /\ inbound' = inbound + 1
    /\ UNCHANGED <<queue, crashed>>

\* A robot crashes silently, ceasing to pick up or deliver without warning.
Crash ==
    /\ ~crashed
    /\ crashed' = TRUE
    /\ UNCHANGED <<inbound, queue, delivered>>

\* A crashed robot restarts.
Recover ==
    /\ crashed
    /\ crashed' = FALSE
    /\ UNCHANGED <<inbound, queue, delivered>>

Next ==
    \/ Pickup
    \/ Deliver
    \/ Return
    \/ Crash
    \/ Recover

\* Conservation: every package is always inbound, staged in the queue, or
\* delivered; none is ever created or destroyed, even across robot crashes.
Conservation ==
    inbound + queue + delivered = Total
====

    Total = 3
    Cap = 2
INIT Init
NEXT Next
INVARIANT Conservation
nl:
A warehouse robot fleet moves a fixed number of packages through a bounded
staging queue. Each package is always either inbound (awaiting pickup), staged
in the queue, or delivered. A robot moves a package from inbound into the
bounded staging queue, but only while the queue has room; once the queue is
full, backpressure blocks further pickups (Pickup). A robot delivers a package
out of the staging queue (Deliver). A delivered package can be returned to the
inbound pool for another cycle (Return). A robot can crash silently, ceasing to
pick up or deliver without warning (Crash), and later restart (Recover).

---- MODULE W4Od1m6p2t0 ----
EXTENDS Naturals

CONSTANTS Controllers, Total, Horizon, TTL

VARIABLES now, ctrl, deadline, pool, aloft, down

TypeOK ==
    /\ now \in 0..Horizon
    /\ ctrl \in Controllers \cup {"none"}
    /\ deadline \in 0..(Horizon + TTL)
    /\ pool \in 0..Total
    /\ aloft \in 0..Total
    /\ down \in BOOLEAN

Init ==
    /\ now = 0
    /\ ctrl = "none"
    /\ deadline = 0
    /\ pool = Total
    /\ aloft = 0
    /\ down = FALSE

\* Real time advances.
Tick ==
    /\ now < Horizon
    /\ now' = now + 1
    /\ UNCHANGED <<ctrl, deadline, pool, aloft, down>>

\* A controller takes the allocation lease with a fresh deadline.
Acquire(c) ==
    /\ ctrl = "none"
    /\ ctrl' = c
    /\ deadline' = now + TTL
    /\ down' = FALSE
    /\ UNCHANGED <<now, pool, aloft>>

\* The live lease holder assigns a landing token, moving it from pool to aloft.
Assign ==
    /\ ctrl # "none"
    /\ ~down
    /\ now <= deadline
    /\ pool > 0
    /\ pool' = pool - 1
    /\ aloft' = aloft + 1
    /\ UNCHANGED <<now, ctrl, deadline, down>>

\* The live lease holder lands an aircraft, returning its token to the pool.
Land ==
    /\ ctrl # "none"
    /\ ~down
    /\ now <= deadline
    /\ aloft > 0
    /\ aloft' = aloft - 1
    /\ pool' = pool + 1
    /\ UNCHANGED <<now, ctrl, deadline, down>>

\* The lease holder crashes silently, ceasing to act without releasing.
Crash ==
    /\ ctrl # "none"
    /\ ~down
    /\ down' = TRUE
    /\ UNCHANGED <<now, ctrl, deadline, pool, aloft>>

\* A crashed holder recovers and resumes.
Recover ==
    /\ down
    /\ down' = FALSE
    /\ UNCHANGED <<now, ctrl, deadline, pool, aloft>>

\* An expired lease is reclaimed.
Expire ==
    /\ ctrl # "none"
    /\ now > deadline
    /\ ctrl' = "none"
    /\ down' = FALSE
    /\ UNCHANGED <<now, deadline, pool, aloft>>

Next ==
    \/ Tick
    \/ \E c \in Controllers : Acquire(c)
    \/ Assign
    \/ Land
    \/ Crash
    \/ Recover
    \/ Expire

\* Conservation: every landing token is always in the pool or aloft; none is
\* ever created or destroyed, even when the holding controller crashes.
Conservation ==
    pool + aloft = Total
====

    Total = 3
    Horizon = 2
    TTL = 1
INIT Init
NEXT Next

An air-traffic runway allocator manages a fixed number of landing tokens, each
of which is always either in the available pool or aloft (assigned to an
in-progress landing). A controller must hold a lease, granted with a deadline a
fixed time-to-live ahead, to move tokens. Real time advances (Tick), and a
controller takes the lease with a fresh deadline (Acquire). While holding a live
lease, the controller assigns a landing token, moving it from the pool to aloft
(Assign), or lands an aircraft, returning its token to the pool (Land). The
lease holder may crash silently, ceasing to act without releasing (Crash), and
may later recover and resume (Recover). An expired lease is reclaimed (Expire).
SAFETY PROPERTY: every landing token is always either in the pool or aloft, so no token is ever created or destroyed, even when the holding controller crashes.

spec_text:
---- MODULE W4Od15m8p3t3 ----
EXTENDS Naturals

CONSTANTS Traders, Sections, Slots

SectionOf(s) == IF s <= 2 THEN 1 ELSE 2

VARIABLES secLock, slotOwner, stalled, target

TypeOK ==
    /\ secLock \in [Sections -> Traders \cup {"free"}]
    /\ slotOwner \in [Slots -> Traders \cup {"free"}]
    /\ stalled \subseteq Traders
    /\ target \in [Traders -> {0} \cup Slots]

Init ==
    /\ secLock = [x \in Sections |-> "free"]
    /\ slotOwner = [s \in Slots |-> "free"]
    /\ stalled = {}
    /\ target = [t \in Traders |-> 0]

\* A trader acquires the coarse lock on a section of the order book.
LockSection(t, x) ==
    /\ t \notin stalled
    /\ secLock[x] = "free"
    /\ secLock' = [secLock EXCEPT ![x] = t]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<slotOwner, stalled, target>>

\* A trader holding a section declares intent to lock one of its price slots.
Target(t, s) ==
    /\ t \notin stalled
    /\ target[t] = 0
    /\ secLock[SectionOf(s)] = t
    /\ target' = [target EXCEPT ![t] = s]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<secLock, slotOwner, stalled>>

\* The fine slot lock is granted only if the trader still holds the enclosing
\* coarse section lock and the slot is free.
LockSlot(t) ==
    /\ t \notin stalled
    /\ target[t] # 0
    /\ slotOwner[target[t]] = "free"
    /\ secLock[SectionOf(target[t])] = t
    /\ slotOwner' = [slotOwner EXCEPT ![target[t]] = t]
    /\ target' = [target EXCEPT ![t] = 0]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<secLock, stalled>>

\* A trader becomes slow, temporarily unable to make progress; it never fails.
Stall(t) ==
    /\ t \notin stalled
    /\ stalled' = stalled \cup {t}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<secLock, slotOwner, target>>

\* A slow trader resumes.
Resume(t) ==
    /\ t \in stalled
    /\ stalled' = stalled \ {t}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<secLock, slotOwner, target>>

\* A trader releases a price slot it holds.
ReleaseSlot(s) ==
    /\ slotOwner[s] # "free"
    /\ slotOwner' = [slotOwner EXCEPT ![s] = "free"]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<secLock, stalled, target>>

\* A trader releases a section only once it holds no slots within it.
ReleaseSection(x) ==
    /\ secLock[x] # "free"
    /\ \A s \in Slots : SectionOf(s) = x => slotOwner[s] = "free"
    /\ secLock' = [secLock EXCEPT ![x] = "free"]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<slotOwner, stalled, target>>

Next ==
    \/ \E t \in Traders, x \in Sections : LockSection(t, x)
    \/ \E t \in Traders, s \in Slots : Target(t, s)
    \/ \E t \in Traders : LockSlot(t)
    \/ \E t \in Traders : Stall(t)
    \/ \E t \in Traders : Resume(t)
    \/ \E s \in Slots : ReleaseSlot(s)
    \/ \E x \in Sections : ReleaseSection(x)

\* No double allocation of the same slot: a price slot is allocated only to the
\* trader holding the coarse section lock covering it, so two traders can never
\* both claim the same slot.
NoDoubleAlloc ==
    \A s \in Slots : slotOwner[s] # "free" => secLock[SectionOf(s)] = slotOwner[s]
====
nl:
A stock exchange opening auction allocates price-level slots to orders using a
two-level hierarchical lock: a trader must hold the coarse lock on a section of
the order book before it may hold the fine lock on a price slot within that
section. A trader acquires the coarse lock on a section (LockSection), then,
while holding it, declares intent to lock one of the section's price slots
(Target). The fine slot lock is granted only if the trader still holds the
enclosing coarse section lock and the slot is free (LockSlot). A trader can be
slow but never fails: it may stall, temporarily unable to make progress
(Stall), and later resume (Resume). A trader releases a price slot it holds
(ReleaseSlot), and releases a section only once it holds no slots within it
(ReleaseSection).
SAFETY PROPERTY: a price slot is allocated only to the trader holding the coarse section lock covering it, so two traders can never both claim the same slot.
